title: Social Catalysts, Not Moral Agents: The Illusion of Alignment in LLM Societies

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring LLM agents' investment decisions in a multi-round Public Goods Game under varying conditions of behavioral visibility (public vs. anonymous) and peer influence (anchoring agents) to detect sycophancy and strategic compliance.

Calculating 'Belief Error' by quantifying the deviation between an agent's subjective expectation of other group members' contributions (extracted from their reasoning chain) and the actual mean contribution of the group.
